Coverage_Description: Network dental care at designated clinics (oral exam/hygiene, intra-oral X-ray if needed, decay fillings, extraction, abscess/emergency treatment, 3-day pain/infection medication); 1-year benefit term
customer requirement: For companies already covered under an AIA group insurance scheme (excluding voluntary/top-up); employer and member enrolment documents required
price structure: Annual premium, paid yearly per insured member; non-guaranteed and subject to revision
